about_the_game:
In Flowers and Deities, you play as an ambitious young commander entering the gods-ruled Emerald City. Lead your army in deadly battles, cast blood-fueled magic, and rise to nobility—or become the next sacrifice.

 

The game combines roguelike progression with auto-battler tactical combat. Deploy units strategically, cast spells in real time, and sacrifice soldiers to gain divine favor. In the Emerald City, strengthen your army, gain blessings, and choose faiths to shape your combat style.

 

  • A captivating and brutal exotic artstyle.

  • Swear allegiance to one of four distinct gods—from the stormy spirit of nature to the sovereign of the dead. Choose your deity and build your tactics around their divine powers:

 

  • Each match features 3 rounds of turn-based duels—deploy units with precision, recruit using Favor, and cast blood magic in real time.

 

  • Every drop of blood on the battlefield becomes instant magical energy. Summon divine familiars, unleash devastating spells, or boost your troops—control the tempo of battle.

 

Survive twelve brutal rounds and defeat the god-chosen champion to claim ultimate victory.

Earn the gods’ favor step by step—and rise above all others.

name: Flowers and Deities

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8
  • Processor: "Flowers & Deities" is a tactical roguelike set in a brutal rainforest world ruled by gods. In the Emerald City of divine rule, you play as an ambitious warlord who pleases the deities by offering deathmatchs. The core combat revolves around "death as resource"—blood spilled by warriors remains on the battlefield as material for powerful magic or summoning mystical creatures. Strategically assemble armies, obtain divine blessings, and forge your legion into an unstoppable force. Ascend as a champion to the gods' promised golden paradise—or become the next sacrificial offering on the altar.
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 670 (2GB) or AMD® Radeon™ HD 7870 (2GB) or Intel® Arc™ A380 (6GB) or Intel® Iris™ Xe G7 (Tiger Lake) or AMD® Radeon™ Vega 8
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-9700K or AMD® Ryzen™ 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1660 Ti/AMD RX 5600-XT/Intel Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
